sources.name: Taste Skill
sources.notes: Design directions, palettes, type pairings, hero and section blueprints, motion recipes, site studies, photo-set metadata, app-screen library, and reference essays.

sources.name: Awesome DESIGN.md
sources.notes: 84 brand design-system analyses with YAML tokens. Brand names are used as references with attribution; no logos or screenshots are redistributed.

sources.name: Vercel Web Interface Guidelines
sources.notes: The audit rubric: accessibility, focus, forms, animation, typography, content handling, images, performance, navigation, touch, layout, dark mode, i18n, hydration, hover, copy, and anti-patterns.

sources.name: Playwright CLI
sources.notes: Browser automation and session-management guidance for the audit loop. The TastePro audit implementation is original; this source informs the workflow and reference skill.
